scope: Read-only transformations of saved public traces, action ledgers and summary charges; source truth fields were not used.

first_cluster_divergence.inference: The same public state, candidate roots, sampled worlds and first transitions have been held equal at this saved decision. Depth two revalues the second macro and terminal cost; after selecting another first task, later public histories also diverge. The complete-game difference is not a measured causal effect of this decision alone.

fee_difference_sign: after minus before; positive means increased cost
caveat: These are five development layouts, not holdout evidence. Equal ordinal windows after histories diverge are not same-state depth comparisons. Charge differences describe full adaptive trajectories and do not isolate the causal contribution of one earlier choice.
